description: investigate and decompose goal: Edit repos/activity-api/src/db/paradigm.ts: in the queryActivitiesByShapes function (around line 840), the candidate pool is truncated by 'ORDER BY ev DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT $limit' before the downstream Thompson draw re-ranks it. Because activity.ev is a dead constant 0.5, this collapses to pure recency truncation and starves earned high-posterior arms before they can be drawn. Fix it by mirroring the ADMISSION_CAP pattern from discover-by-shapes.ts: introduce an admission cap of 1000 and use LIMIT max(limit, 1000) so a bounded superset is admitted and the downstream Thompson re-rank does the selecting. Update the stale comment above the query that wrongly claims 'ev DESC surfaces the top-performing templates first'.
